description: SvTree editing in Svelte 5: drag-and-drop reordering that drops before, after or inside a node, inline rename on double-click or F2, and sortable siblings. onMove receives the dragged id, the target id and the drop position, and the exported moveTreeNode helper applies the move to the nodes array; onRename delivers the new label.
keywords: svelte 5 tree drag and drop reorder

faq.question: How do I apply a drop?
faq.answer: In onMove call moveTreeNode(nodes, dragId, targetId, position) and assign the result. It removes the node from its old parent and inserts it before, after or inside the target.

faq.question: How does inline rename work?
faq.answer: With editable on, double-click or F2 turns the label into an input; Enter commits through onRename and Escape cancels.

faq.question: Why is reorder disabled while sorting?
faq.answer: A sorted tree orders siblings by label, so a manual position would be overridden immediately; the demo enables reorderable only when sort is off.
